annotations.title: Crypto token price in USD from Uniswap v3 pools

description: Crypto token USD price by ticker (ETH, BTC, USDC, AERO, ARB, OP, LINK…) or by any ERC-20 0x address on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum or Optimism, from the deepest Uniswap v3 pool against USDC or WETH, read live from the chain. Returns the pool, its fee tier, the quote reserve and a thin-liquidity flag. Spot price, not a time average. No pool returns 404, uncharged. Use to value a token or check a quote before a swap or payment. Example: symbol=ETH. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

address.description: 0x ERC-20 token contract address (instead of symbol)

chain.description: Network: base (default), eth, arb or op

symbol.description: Ticker such as ETH, BTC, USDC, AERO, ARB, OP or LINK (instead of address; ETH and BTC mean the wrapped tokens)
